message: The other day, I found myself packing a go-bag for a quick weekend trip, and I realized I might be a bit of an over-prepared person. 🙈 I had snacks, a first-aid kit, extra chargers, and even a mini flashlight—just in case! It made me think that while it might seem excessive, having a little extra readiness can make all the difference in enjoying time away from home. What’s your favorite preparedness tip or trick?
